prerequisites: To enroll in this course, it is necessary to have passed or be enrolled in all subjects from previous academic years relative to the year in which this course is placed.

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the basic aspects of different handling and transport alternatives in any field.
Master the current techniques available for the analysis of movement of loads or people in the industrial field.
Deepen in the techniques of movement of loads or people in the industrial field.
Acquire skills on the process of analysis of movement of loads or people in the industrial field.
Ability to design systems, components or processes that meet specific transport needs, using the most appropriate methods, techniques and tools in each case.
Ability for critical evaluation in the industrial field of the movement of loads or people.

syllabus_topics: Various Elements: Pulleys, Tackle, Drums, Rails and Wheels
Exterior cranes: port, shipyard or construction site
The elevator: Types, operation, mechanical and electrical parts, control.

assessment_methods.method: Practice report, practicum and external practices

assessment_rules: Within the weight of the exam and practice report, evaluation may be done through supervised projects, not necessarily evaluative tests. Those who do not follow continuous assessment will take a different exam covering all course material than those who do. Students are expected to demonstrate appropriate ethical behavior. In case of detecting unethical behavior (copying, plagiarism, use of unauthorized electronic devices, and others), the student will be considered not to meet the necessary requirements to pass the course, and the global grade for the current academic year will be a fail (0.0).
